implementation_summary: review-model.ts: pure helpers. ReviewDraft holds unsaved changes. Setters cover finding fields, finding reset, Section text and reset, page remove/restore (a change back to the saved state is dropped), and redesign/repair choice and reset. draftToPatch builds the AuditEditsPatch (findings, sections with reset: true, removePages/restorePages, recommendations) and leaves out empty lists. findingRows, sectionRows, hierarchyTree and recommendationRows merge AuditGetReply.result, the saved EditOverlay and the draft for display, with originals kept. review-api.ts: loadAudit, loadEdits, loadPageContent and saveEdits call AUDIT_API get/getEdits/content/patchEdits through auditPath, with version and path as query values; refusals become plain sentences. ReviewDocumentsScreen.tsx: ReviewDocumentsView is presentational. It shows the hierarchy with Remove/Restore and Edit Sections, a Sections editor (labelled textarea, original beside, reset), labelled finding fields (originals beside, reset), and a redesign-or-repair radio fieldset per Sample Page, plus Save and Discard and loading, error and no-result states. ReviewDocumentsScreen is the container: it loads the audit and Page Content, saves, and reloads the stored edits when a save fails. Correction (EV-0065): the imports test now checks my three named files explicitly (each must exist; @qa/types only via '@qa/types/src/browser.js'; no node:, @qa/core, @qa/runner or @qa/checkers) instead of requiring the folder to hold only those files. Every other assertion is unchanged.
